english.note: Use this before a noun when the activity or process requires unusually large amounts of labour, money, materials, or other resources.

examples.english: This industry is intensive in its use of resources, so it is not easy to develop in Hong Kong.
examples.traditional: 呢種資源密集型工業，需要好多勞工同資金，唔係咁易喺香港發展。
